name: Goro Takeshi
source: By nature he is a very energetic guy thus he is time to time really troublesome. But the older he grew the more pleasant he is at times. He is always spontaneous and has his problems act like planned.
translation: By nature he is a very energetic guy thus he is time to time really troublesome. But the older he grew the more pleasant he is at times. He is always spontaneous and has his problems act like planned.
